verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              सोऽतिगर्जन् धनुष्पाणिर्ज्यां विकर्षन् पुनः पुनः।  तयोर्महात्मनोस्तूर्णं रथान्तरमवापतत्॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Then that brother of Karna armed with a bow and stretching its string repeatedly, soon placed himself between those two high-souled car-warriors.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽविध्यद्दशभिर्बाणैरभिमन्युं दुरासदम्।  सच्छत्रध्वजयन्तारं साश्वमाशु स्मयन्निव॥२॥
verses.english: Then with arrows, shot from his bow drawn to a circle and resembling snakes of virulent poison in touch, Abhimanyu quickly cut-off Karna's umbrella, standard, horses and charioteer, smiling all the while.

verses.sanskrit: पितृपैतामहं कर्म कुर्वाणमतिमानुषम्।  दृष्ट्वार्दितं शरैः कार्णीं त्वदीया हृषिता भवन्॥३॥
तस्याभिमन्युरायम्य स्मयन्नेकेन पत्रिणा। शिरः प्रच्यावयामास तद्रथात् प्रापतद्भुवि॥४॥
verses.english: Thereupon Abhimanyu smiled and bending his bow shot a winged shaft that lopped off his antagonist's head and then the latter fell down from his chariot.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णिकारमिवाधूतं वातेनापतितं नगात्।  भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा राजन् कर्णो व्यथां ययौ॥५॥
verses.english: The, O monarch, Karna was extremely pained on seeing his brother slain and overthrown like a blossoming Karnikara tree thrown drown by the wind from the mountain top.

verses.sanskrit: विमुखीकृत्य कर्णं तु सौभद्रः कङ्कपत्रिभिः।  अन्यानपि महेष्वासांस्तूर्णमेवाभिदुद्रुवे॥६॥
ततस्तद्वितततं सैन्यं हस्त्यश्वरथपत्तिमत्। क्रुद्धोऽभिमन्युरभिनत्तिग्मतेजा महारथः॥७॥
verses.english: Then Abhimanyu possessed of fierce energy and great renown, wrought up with rage, began to break through the various division of cars, elephants, steeds and infantry.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णस्तु बहुभिर्बाणैरर्द्यमानोऽभिमन्युना। अपायाज्जवनैरश्वैस्ततोऽनीकमभज्यत॥८॥
verses.english: Meanwhile Karna who had been afflicted by Abhimanyu with his myriads of shafts, fled away from the field of battle, being borne by fleet steeds. Your army then began to give way.

verses.sanskrit: शलभैरिव चाकाशे धाराभिरिव चावृते।  अभिमन्योः शरै राजन्न प्राज्ञायत किंचन॥९॥
verses.english: Then when the sky was covered with the arrows of Abhimanyu, like the flights of locusts or thick showers of rain, o king, nothing could be distinguished.

verses.sanskrit: तावकानां तु योधानां वध्यतां निशितैः शरैः।  अन्यत्र सैन्धवाद्राजन्न स्म कश्चिदतिष्ठत॥१०॥
verses.english: Amongst all your warriors then thus slaughtered by Abhimanyu with his sharp shafts, none stayed on the field, except the ruler of the Sindhus.

verses.sanskrit: सौभद्रस्तु ततः शंखं प्रध्माप्य पुरुषर्षभः।  शीघ्रमभ्यपतत् सेनां भारतीं भरतर्षभ॥११॥
स कक्षेऽग्निरिवोत्सृष्टो निर्दहंस्तरसा रिपून्।  मध्यं भारतसैन्यानामार्जुनिः पर्यवर्तत॥१२॥
verses.english: Then like fire set to work on a heap of dried grass, consuming the hostile ranks, Arjuna's son moved in circles amidst the Kaurava hou.

verses.sanskrit: रथनागाश्वमनुजानर्दयन्निशितैः शरैः।  संप्रविश्याकरोद्भूमिं कबन्धगणसंकुलाम्॥१३॥
verses.english: Breaking through the hostije array, he began to afflict car-warriors, elephant-riders, horse-men and infantry with his great arrows; and thus made the earth impassable with headless trunks.

verses.sanskrit: सौभद्रचापप्रभवैर्निकृत्ताः परमेषुभिः।  स्वानेवाभिमुखान् घ्नन्तः प्राद्रवन् जीवितार्थिनः॥१४॥
verses.english: Mangled with the shafts of excellent make, shot from the bow of Subhadra's son, the Kauravas fled in fear of their lives, slaying, as they ran, their own partisans that happened to meet them.

verses.sanskrit: ते घोरा रौद्रकर्माणो विपाठा बहवः शिताः।  निघ्नन्तो रथनागाश्वान् जग्मुराशु वसुंधराम्॥१५॥
verses.english: Those dreadful shafts of terrible effects and touch, penetrating penetrating through car-warriors, elephants and horses, struck on the earth's surface.

verses.sanskrit: सायुधाः सांगुलित्राणाः सगदाः साङ्गदा रणे।  दृश्यन्ते बाहवश्छिन्ना हेमाभरणभूषिताः॥१६॥
verses.english: With weapons in grasp, with fingerpreservers, with maces in clutch and with Angadas and decked with golden ornaments, arms were seen to be strewn on the ground.

verses.sanskrit: शराश्चापानि खड्गाश्च शरीराणि शिरांसि च।  सकुण्डलानि स्रग्वीणि भूमावासन् सहस्रशः॥१७॥
सोपस्करैरधिष्ठानैरीषादण्डैश्च बन्धुरैः।  अक्षैर्विमथितैश्चक्रैर्बहुधा पतितैर्युगैः॥१८॥
verses.english: Strewn over with Upashkaras, Adishthanas, long poles and with shattered Akshasas and broken wheels and yokes, thousands in number, with arrows, bows, swords, fallen standards; with backless bows and shafts scattered about, with the bodies of slain Kshatriyas, horses and elephants, the field of battle looking fierce soon became impassable.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिचापासिभिश्चैव पतितैश्च महाध्वजैः।  चर्मचापशरैश्चैव व्यवकीर्णैः समन्ततः॥१९॥
निहतैः क्षत्रियैरश्वैर्वारणैश्च विशांपते।  अगम्यरूपा पृथिवी क्षणेनासीत् सुदारुणा॥२०॥
वध्यतां राजपुत्राणां क्रन्दतामितरेतरम्।  प्रादुरासीन्महाशब्दो भीरूणां भयवर्धनः॥२१॥
verses.english: Then as the princes were being slaughtered by Abhimanyu, they created a loud noise enhancing the apprehension of the cowards by calling one another by their names.

verses.sanskrit: स शब्दो भरतश्रेष्ठ दिशः सर्वा व्यनादयत्।  सौभद्रश्चाद्रवत् सेनां घ्नन् वराश्वरथद्विपान्॥२२॥
verses.english: That din, O foremost of the Bharatas, filled all the points of the compass with its echo; the son of Subhadra then assailed the Kauravas host killing excellent car-warriors, steeds and elephants.

verses.sanskrit: कक्षमग्निरिवोत्सृष्टो निर्दहंस्तरसा रिपून्।  मध्ये भारतसैन्यानामार्जुनिः प्रत्यदृश्यत॥२३॥
विचरन्तं दिशः सर्वाः प्रदिशश्चापि भारत।  तं तदा नानुपश्यामः सैन्ये च रजसाऽऽवृते॥२४॥
आददानं गजाश्वानां नृणां चायूंषि भारत।  क्षणेन भूयः पश्यामः सूर्यं मध्यंदिने यथा॥२५॥
verses.english: The next moment, O Bharata, we beheld him shining like the mid-day sun and wrenching the lives out of elephants, steeds and men.

verses.sanskrit: अभिमन्युं महाराज प्रतपन्तं द्विषद्गणान्।  स वासवसमः संख्ये वासवस्यात्मजात्मजः। अभिमन्युर्महाराज सैन्यमध्ये व्यरोचत॥२६॥
